data.one_liner: LDAP v3 client for Dart, supports search, add, modify, delete, and connection pooling
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart API to connect to LDAP v3 servers, perform CRUD operations, and stream search results. Includes experimental connection pool and logging.
use_when: Need to query or modify an LDAP directory from a Dart app
Working with directory services in a server or CLI tool
Implementing authentication backends that rely on LDAP
avoid_when: You only need simple HTTP or REST APIs
Your project targets only web browsers (LDAP requires sockets)
strengths: Full LDAP v3 support with search, modify, and referrals
Stream-based search results for efficient handling
Experimental connection pool for reuse and retry
Good logging integration via Dart logging
weaknesses: Experimental pool may lack advanced features
No built‑in UI components, purely backend
Requires native socket support (not available on web)
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, import package, create LdapConnection with host/port, optionally enable SSL. No build_runner needed.
